claims.claim: UBC researchers contributed to the identification of 15,000 new candidate strong gravitational lenses in early Euclid data.
claims.episode_span: UBC researchers contributed to the identification of 15,000 new candidate strong gravitational lenses. These candidates came from early Euclid data.

claims.claim: Franciscan Health physicians performed the first reported bone marrow transplant using tissue from a deceased organ donor to treat aplastic anemia in a 40-year-old woman with a ten-year history of the disease.
claims.episode_span: Franciscan Health physicians in the American Midwest performed the first reported bone marrow transplant using tissue from a deceased organ donor. The recipient was a 40-year-old woman. She had a ten-year history of the disease.
claims.source_title: World-First Bone Marrow Transplant Successfully Treats Non-Malignant Disease
